sources.title: FAO Marine Lobsters of the World: selected Homarus key and species accounts
sources.scope: Actual FAO PDFpage8 printed57 Fig104/105 and page11 printed60 Fig110 rendered/read. Naked major palms and the absent ventral rostral tooth distinguish the selected European form. Earlier web-parser page offsets were incorrect and are corrected here. No full-volume review, measurement fit, historical fisheries or physiological parameter import.

sources.title: Macmillan1975 — A physiological analysis of walking in the American lobster
sources.scope: Primary-paper PubMed abstract read only, not full experimental paper. Forward stepping of four walking pairs and variable phase relationships provide context. This model uses a fixed illustrative sequence, without original EMG, transducer signals, measured joint coordinates or fitted gait. Related H.americanus research, not species-measured H.gammarus biomechanics.

shape.before: The earlier withheld oval/rod-limbed draft is preserved on the body sheet.
shape.changed: A continuous robust carapace, unequal naked crusher/cutter palms, shorter crusher fingers, a spiny rostrum without a ventral tooth, eight jointed walking limbs including small P2/P3 chelae, six overlapping abdominal plates and a five-part tail fan replace the oval/rod draft.
shape.remaining: Exact body ratios, rostral teeth, orbital/buccal plates, cutting dentition, joint axes, telson/uropod struts and setal fields remain unmeasured or incomplete. Palms, dorsal grooves and pleurae are still simplified. First sex-modified pleopods are not reconstructed. The source photo does not establish sex, optics or the entire species' variation.

surface.changed: Selected dark blue cuticle, restrained cream speckles, reddish palms and antennae, pale seam edges and original curved surfaces remain on the same retained model through all actions.
surface.remaining: Original numerical illustration, without calibrated optics, scan or full natural variation. Exact body ratios, rostral teeth, orbital/buccal plates, cutting dentition, joint axes, telson/uropod struts and setal fields remain unmeasured or incomplete. Palms, dorsal grooves and pleurae are still simplified. First sex-modified pleopods are not reconstructed. The source photo does not establish sex, optics or the entire species' variation.

movement.changed: A short authored forward supported bout, local chela/antennule handling, finger opening, quiet support and partial six-joint abdominal/fan flex retain the same meshes. Pleopod pairs2–5 have simple local articulation; no measured escape, sensory function, ingestion or hydrodynamics.
movement.remaining: No measured coordinates, natural playback rate, joint limits, forces, fluid dynamics, muscle, food contact, ingestion, sensory physiology or independent biological validation. Fixed-length/support checks establish internal software consistency only.

sourceAssessment: The authentic Bart Braun public-domain photograph and selected actual FAO figures were compared: PDFpage8 printed57 Fig104/105, page11 printed60 Fig110. The former draft's parser page offsets are corrected. Related H.americanus walking context is from Macmillan1975's PubMed abstract only; no full experimental record or species-measured H.gammarus gait was imported.
fixesAfterRenderedReview: Reduced excessive pale speckling after the first side/top comparison.
Shortened the crusher fingers relative to the cutter and narrowed the quiet finger gap.
Replaced coarse stock palm geometry with dense dimensioned surfaces to remove large star-shaped pigment patches.
Corrected cuticle/fan winding and kept five separate tail-fan parts with fixed anchors.
Bound the three anatomy markers to the carapace, actual crusher palm and moving fan, and corrected the inherited label names.

assessmentRubric.identity: Accepted species-rank concept checked; photographed organism remains source-labelled
assessmentRubric.body: Substantial initial correction; unmeasured dimensions and incomplete fine diagnostic anatomy
assessmentRubric.texture: Distinct selected numerical surface; optics and microanatomy remain illustrative
assessmentRubric.movement: Working qualitative supported articulation; empirical rate/dynamics unvalidated

reviewMethod: 55 actual final nonblank side/front/top, enlarged and action/posture states inspected individually on labelled sheets against the authentic photograph and scoped sources. Superseded frames excluded. Qualitative author assessment, not independent expert certification.
